chapters.title: Building a deal record you can trust
Conclusion: keep the deal folder current

takeaways: An opportunity is one potential sale linked to an account or contact, created by qualifying a lead or directly for existing customers.
The qualify, develop, propose and close stages make sure budget, decision maker, stakeholders and internal review are covered before a deal is called close.
Keeping revenue, close dates and probability current and closing deals promptly as won or lost keeps the forecast honest.
hook: Many sales teams track deals in scattered notes and spreadsheets, so nobody knows what will really close. This episode walks sellers and sales managers through opportunity management in Dynamics 365 Sales, from lead qualification through the four pipeline stages to closing as won or lost. You will learn how to keep a deal record your team and your forecast can trust.
